GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (17 Feb 46) LS
(SCAPIN - 748)
APO 500
17 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 21 January 1946, file and subject as above, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one TAYA, Mitsyoshi, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said TAYA's name. This name appears as the 3rd name, page No.5 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
